mapping.gates: Exact internal names/types/Required; not hidden/read-only. SenderParticipantId and RecipientParticipantId are existing Number columns with XML Decimals=0, not lookups. Row values must be positive mathematically whole Numbers (recipient may be null for Group), checked by equals(value,int(value)); normalize integers before live-key string construction. Id/TargetGroupId retain integer validation. Both send/live keys required unique indexed; TargetGroup lookup exact Groups GUID; choices exact/count/no fill-in; Participantaccount required unique indexed User; complete bounded reads only.
mapping.mismatch: REQUEST_SCHEMA_UNVERIFIED; do not guess/rename/autocreate/backfill. Parent #10 shared metadata preflight supplies evidence; no extra audit package.

observedPreflight.gate: Owner adds six fields and toggles existing RecipientParticipantId Required off, preserving existing Number columns/IDs, then runs corrected shared preflight. OperationComplete optional Boolean defaults No. No tenant changes performed here.

reads.request: One exact GUID/item-id read before write and one exact outcome read after an attempted CAS; no request scans, membership/group reads or writes.

receipt.whySufficient: One lifetime sender cancellation decision, no payload and no reopening. Row Id + immutable sender/parties/type/send key bind intent. Pending-only exact-ETag CAS atomically saves Status, history key, winner and completion. Changing target yields a different explicit operation identity. One same-request retry reads saved terminal winner; no second logical result or fresh UUID is created.
receipt.scope: Bounded request decision receipt only, not cross-list acceptance/group coordination, reusable operation platform, notification receipt or schema migration. All consumers must preserve terminal history/parties and prohibit reopening; source legacy rows lacking keys/completion are not repaired.

write.ifMatch: Exact verbose read __metadata.etag; quoted numeric ETag, never wildcard.
write.verification: Reread exact row, typed snapshot, unchanged Id/sender/recipient/group/type/SendOperationKey, coherent live/history key, winner/completion and caller binding. Only exact own complete Cancelled is success.

outputs.success: Boolean: true only for proved own saved cancellation; ALREADY_DECIDED is false.
outputs.message: Text: constant sanitized user wording; original output field types preserved.
outputs.resultcode: CANCELLED | ALREADY_DECIDED | ACCEPTED_INCOMPLETE | RETRY_REQUIRED | OUTCOME_UNKNOWN | REQUEST_INTEGRITY | REQUEST_SCHEMA_UNVERIFIED | UNAUTHORIZED | INVALID_INPUT | READ_OR_DATA_FAILED
outputs.currentstatus: Authorized coherent current status only; blank on validation/read/authority error.
outputs.operationcomplete: Boolean: observed saved completion; Accepted-incomplete remains false.
outputs.replay: Boolean: true only for pre-existing same-key saved cancellation.
outputs.writeattempted: Boolean: flow entered the single write attempt.
outputs.outcomeunknown: Boolean: attempted write lacks reliable proof, including failed post-write integrity checks; never interpret failure as no effect.

recovery.412: Always reread exact outcome. Saved same-key cancel -> CANCELLED; other coherent terminal -> ALREADY_DECIDED or ACCEPTED_INCOMPLETE. Still Pending -> RETRY_REQUIRED, no automatic reissue.
recovery.502timeout: No duplicate-code shortcut. Exact positive readback can prove cancellation. Otherwise OUTCOME_UNKNOWN; typed duplicate exception alone is also insufficient and is not classified as success/no-effect.
recovery.uncertain: Refresh/retry same request. If outcome/record remains inconsistent, exceptional owner assistance checks settled runs and history. No rollback, alternate key or TTL steal.

legacy: Missing/malformed/incomplete keys, parties, ETag, status or marker -> REQUEST_INTEGRITY; preserve row unchanged. Blank/whitespace send key rejected. Canonical send UUID issuance remains Send scope, not guessed for #17 by cancellation.
